works.projectDescription: Built Trip Genie, an AI-powered travel assistant designed to help tourists explore cities and governorates across Egypt. The app creates smart travel plans based on the selected destination, offering personalized itineraries, visit recommendations, and helpful travel tips. It also provides detailed information about landmarks, attractions, and popular places in each governorate, making it easier for travelers to discover Egypt in a more organized and interactive way.

Teamed up with a team to transform a non-invasive blood sugar monitoring device into a smart app. The SugarCheck app supports individual accounts for patients and caregivers, displaying real-time measurement results from the device. It leverages Supabase for data storage, includes a Machine Learning model for predicting diabetes, tracks patient medications, and features a chatbot with daily health tips powered by Gemini API.

Built Tasky, a productivity app designed to help users manage daily tasks and stay organized more efficiently. The app allows users to create, update, prioritize, and track tasks with a clean and intuitive interface. It also includes a dedicated notes section for writing quick thoughts, reminders, and personal notes, making it easier to manage both tasks and ideas in one place. Tasky was built as a practice project to strengthen app architecture skills, state management, and local data handling while focusing on creating a smooth and user-friendly productivity experience.
Created OpenFashion app, a platform for selling clothes and accessories. The app includes a section for adding delivery addresses and a secure option to add credit card details for online payments.
